text.title: Python Type Hints Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the typed-module spec emitted by this methodology — covers checker config, file allowlist, ignore policy, the four boolean gates, and version metadata.

section.title: Typed-module spec schema
section.code: { "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://faion.net/schemas/python-type-hints-spec.json", "type": "object", "required": [ "python_version", "mode", "strict_files", "checker", "strict_at_boundary", "pydantic_at_io", "no_legacy_typing_imports", "no_bare_any", "version", "last_reviewed" ], "properties": { "python_version": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^3\\.(9|1[0-9])$"}, "mode": {"enum": ["greenfield", "legacy", "library"]}, "checker": {"enum": ["mypy", "pyright"]}, "strict_files": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}, "test_relax": {"type": "boolean", "default": true}, "ignore_policy": {"enum": ["coded-only", "any"], "default": "coded-only"}, "future_annotations_pydantic_v2_only": {"type": "boolean", "default": true}, "strict_at_boundary": {"type": "boolean", "const": true}, "pydantic_at_io": {"type": "boolean", "const": true}, "no_legacy_typing_imports": {"type": "boolean", "const": true}, "no_bare_any": {"type": "boolean", "const": true}, "pep695_generics": {"type": "boolean", "default": false}, "version": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+$"}, "last_reviewed": {"type": "string", "format": "date"} } }
section.note: The four `const: true` booleans are the gates carried over from the backend copy of this methodology: the checker runs strict at the boundary (`strict-at-boundary`), every IO boundary is parsed by Pydantic v2 (`pydantic-at-io`), no `typing.List`/`Optional`/`Union` imports remain (`pep604-only`), and no bare `Any` was introduced (`no-bare-any`). A spec reporting any of them false is a spec describing an unfinished migration.

example.code: { "python_version": "3.12", "mode": "legacy", "checker": "mypy", "strict_files": ["src/api/handlers.py", "src/services/billing.py"], "test_relax": true, "ignore_policy": "coded-only", "future_annotations_pydantic_v2_only": true, "strict_at_boundary": true, "pydantic_at_io": true, "no_legacy_typing_imports": true, "no_bare_any": true, "pep695_generics": true, "version": "1.0.0", "last_reviewed": "2026-05-22" }

example.note: python_version 3.8 below minimum (3.9 required for `list[T]`); mode value not in enum; ignore_policy=any forbidden in this methodology (coded-only mandated); all four gates red — the methodology has not actually been applied; missing version + last_reviewed + strict_files.
